aboutText: Based in Preston, Aus Projects & Solutions is a young but passionate cabinet making business. We take pride in our excellent customer service and the extensive projects we have created and been a part of. From small custom pieces to large-scale joinery, projects are what we love and the challenge drives us. Serving Preston and surrounding areas, we are dedicated to delivering high-quality craftsmanship.
servicesText: At Aus Projects & Solutions, we specialise in a range of cabinet making and carpentry services. From custom kitchen cabinets to bespoke furniture, we handle projects of all sizes with precision and care. Serving Preston and beyond, our skilled team brings your visions to life.

services.title: Custom Kitchen Cabinets

services.title: Shop Fittings
